verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Sandbox testing environment (square-docs-13), and its in-person surfaces (Mobile Payments SDK, Terminal API, Tap to Pay) are documented. However, the evidence is only a page title and never ties the Sandbox to in-person flows, simulated readers, or test cards. missing for 10: evidence that the sandbox covers Mobile Payments SDK/Terminal API in-person flows, a simulated reader or device, test card numbers or values for card-present payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end in-person testing.
